coverage.notes: POST /api/v1/products/image-urls:batch accepts N IDs and returns one signed cover URL per product.
Reuses SqlAlchemyProductRepository.get_by_id with the same tenant-scoped vs. admin-cross-org logic as the single-product endpoint.
_key_tenant_allowed runs per signed key with the same admin relaxation as the single-product endpoint.
Endpoint signs only the selected cover (thumbnail or cover_image_key fallback), never the gallery.
Calls generators.space.generate_cdn_download_url (CDN signer), not generate_download_url. CDN-routed URL surfaced to the browser.
process_thumbnail produces a centered square crop, exactly 600x600, WebP-encoded.
Upload path invokes spaces.upload_file without make_public for the thumbnail path; bucket stays private.
ProductModel.thumbnail_image_key column (nullable, 500 chars) plus the reversible Alembic migration 20260922_0001_add_thumbnail_image_key_to_product.py.
Batch endpoint surfaces the signed thumbnail URL via covers[].url; single product response (ProductResponse) already exposes thumbnail_image_key in the DTO.
Endpoint picks thumbnail_image_key when present, else cover_image_key; no thumbnail and no cover = product omitted from the response.
generate_cdn_download_url signs against the configured cdn_endpoint with host-bound signature (CDN-routed URL).
DOSpacesService._require_cdn_signer raises StorageUploadError on missing do_cdn_endpoint (NFR5.1 fail-fast).
Same generate_cdn_download_url surfaces both thumbnail and (future) gallery signed URLs; CDN-routing consistent across surfaces.
DELETE /products/{id}/images/{key} calls PurgeProductImageUseCase.execute synchronously; CDN purge + storage delete happen before the 200 response.
Storage object is deleted via spaces.delete_file; CDN purge happens first; the response confirms both ran.
The use case runs the synchronous invalidate + storage delete before returning the outcome label; the handler builds the 200 response only after.
When invalidate raises CdnInvalidationError, the use case enqueues a Taskiq retry (queued_retry outcome); the new image is retained (storage delete still runs).
ProductCard consumes a single imageUrl prop (unchanged); unoptimized is set when imageUrl is provided (FR5.3, signed-MINIO host-binding preserved).
Replaced per-product useQueries fan-out with one POST against /api/v1/products/image-urls:batch (NFR1.1).
Image component still receives unoptimized={Boolean(imageUrl)} so signed CDN URLs bypass next/image optimization.
Hook returns Map<id, null> when the backend omits a product (legacy fallback path uses attributes.image_urls; product stays decoupled here).
Batch endpoint reads products cross-tenant for ORG_ADMIN_VIEW_ALL users (matches the single-product endpoint).
Tenant-prefix check (_key_tenant_allowed) is identical for own-org and cross-org paths; no per-role relaxation.
Single POST regardless of K products (test asserts exactly one fetch for two visible IDs).

coverage.evidence: Intentionally not measurable at this stage (no real CDN endpoint in unit tests).
coverage.notes: Per unit-test-instructions: 'NFR1.2 and NFR1.3 require later measured p95 evidence; unit tests alone cannot prove timings in real CDN infrastructure.' Belongs to performance-validation (Stage 4.6). NOT claimed here.

coverage.evidence: Intentionally not measurable at this stage (no real CDN endpoint in unit tests).
coverage.notes: Same posture as NFR1.2; requires p95 measurement against a warm CDN cache.
Thumbnail upload does NOT pass make_public=True; bucket stays private. Signed CDN URL required to access.
Authorization + tenant-prefix check both run per signed key in the batch endpoint; same allowlist as the single-product endpoint.
DOSpacesService.DEFAULT_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRES_IN = 900 seconds (15 minutes); surfaced as expires_in in the batch response.
When CDN invalidate fails, the storage object is still deleted and a Taskiq retry is enqueued. Response stays 2xx.
Same posture as NFR3.1 (CDN invalidation has the same compensation contract as storage deletion).
Endpoint logs 'Batch cover-URL signing: batch_size=%d user_id=%s tenant_id=%s' on every request; no signed URL or raw key in the log line.
Outcome labels 'success' / 'queued_retry' / 'failed_no_retry' are stable strings logged by the use case + handler. No signed URL or raw key in any log.
NFR4.3 is structural here — NFR4.3's cache hit/miss metrics live in the CDN provider and the use case emits the structured log records needed for ops dashboards.
DOSpacesService._require_cdn_signer raises StorageUploadError on blank do_cdn_endpoint; DigitalOceanCdnInvalidator raises CdnInvalidationError when purge_url is blank. Same fail-fast posture.
Reversible Alembic migration adds thumbnail_image_key (nullable, String(500)). Upgrade / downgrade both defined. Same mechanism as 20260812_0002_migrate_legacy_sedan_products.py.

open_questions_resolution.decision: Runtime fallback to cover_image_key. No backfill migration. Resolution: surfaced in code-summary.md; documented in tests/unit/api/routers/test_batch_product_cover_urls.py::TestBatchCoverUrlsLegacyFallback.
15-minute TTL via DOSpacesService.DEFAULT_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRES_IN (already established). Surfaces as expires_in in the batch response.

Hard cap of 100 product IDs per batch. Pydantic max_length returns 422; handler-level guard returns 413. Documented in BATCH_COVER_URLS_MAX_PRODUCTS and test_batch_product_cover_urls.py::TestBatchCoverUrlsBatchCap.
